requisito: Filters valid catalog entries (ignoring null or empty elements) by case-insensitive substring when filtro is non-empty, then returns the 1-based page along with the percentage of filtered items shown. Returns "non valido" if voci is null or pagina/perPagina are not positive; if there are no entries or the page is past the end, returns an empty list.

difetti.indizio: Check how each array element is handled before trimming whitespace.
difetti.spiegazione: Calling raw!.Trim() before checking whether raw is null throws a NullReferenceException as soon as the array contains a null entry.

difetti.indizio: Look at the condition deciding whether the requested page exceeds the total page count.
difetti.spiegazione: Using pagina >= totalePagine instead of > discards the very last valid page, returning an empty list whenever pagina equals totalePagine.

difetti.indizio: Look at how each entry is matched against the filter substring.
difetti.spiegazione: StringComparison.Ordinal makes the search case-sensitive, violating the case-insensitive filtering requirement.

difetti.indizio: Check the types used when calculating the starting page offset.
difetti.spiegazione: The product (pagina - 1) * perPagina is evaluated as int: with a large page number it overflows to negative, slips past inizio >= totale, and throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException when indexing the list.

difetti.indizio: Look at the condition applying the text filter to catalog entries.
difetti.spiegazione: The negation ! is missing in front of pulita.Contains(...): the loop skips matching entries instead of non-matching ones.

difetti.indizio: Look at how the coverage percentage is calculated near the end of the function.
difetti.spiegazione: mostrati, 100, and totale are all int, so integer division truncates decimals (for example, 37.5 becomes 37) before assigning to double.
